'''2004 GameStorm''' was a gaming convention in Portland, Oregon, held on 5–7 March 2004, at which [[David Kangas]] and [[Edward Fones]] ran a weekend of ''Star Wars'' CCG events.<ref name="pcf-2668-39624">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39624#39624 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The convention was held at the DoubleTree hotel next to Jantzen Beach, 1401 N. Hayden Island Drive, Portland.<ref name="pcf-2668-40210">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40210#40210 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2668-40260">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260#40260 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Convention entry, covering all three days, was $25, or $30 after 1 February or at the door;<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" /> under convention policy the tournaments had no table fees.<ref name="pcf-2668-40142">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40142#40142 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The author Michael Stackpole was due to attend, and Kangas invited players to have their [[Corran Horn]] cards signed by him.<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' DoubleTree hotel, 1401 N. Hayden Island Drive, Portland, Oregon<ref name="pcf-2668-40210" /><ref name="pcf-2668-40260" />
* '''Dates:''' 5–7 March 2004<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" />
* '''Organizers:''' [[David Kangas]] and [[Edward Fones]]<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" />
* '''Entry:''' convention admission only; no table fees<ref name="pcf-2668-40142" />

== Schedule ==

Kangas posted the planned ''Star Wars'' CCG schedule on 2 February 2004:<ref name="pcf-2668-40142" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Day !! Time !! Event
|-
| Friday || 4 PM || [[Enhanced Premiere]] [[Secret Squirrel]] with a mix of [[Premiere]] and [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] boosters; foils as prizes
|-
| Saturday || 12 PM || Open-format constructed, six one-hour games; packs and high-end tournament foils as prizes. Kangas was trying to have it made a mini-qualifier for the [[2004 World Championship|World Championship]].
|-
| Saturday || 8 PM || [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] sealed draft, 12 boxes, four 45-minute games; foils as prizes
|-
| Sunday || 9:30 AM || [[Classic]] constructed, four one-hour games; high-end foils as prizes
|-
| Sunday || 1:30 PM || [[Booster Draft]] of [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] boosters; foils as prizes
|}

Fones posted a "hard schedule" on 11 February 2004 that moved the Secret Squirrel to 4:30 PM, the sealed draft to 7 PM and the Classic event to 10 AM; the Saturday open event was six rounds, with prizes of high-end foils, packs and a [[Premiere Unlimited|white-border Premiere]] set cut from an uncut sheet.<ref name="pcf-2668-40480">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40480#40480 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The foil prizes named by Kangas included two sets of [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]], [[A Few Maneuvers]] and [[Dark Maneuvers]], and [[Imperial Arrest Order]] and [[Insurrection]].<ref name="pcf-2668-40615">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40615#40615 Star Wars @ GameStorm, Portland OR March 5-7], David Kangas (Shadow 31), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152649/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40260%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The organizers also planned free Ophidian 2350 demonstrations and sealed-deck tournaments.<ref name="pcf-2668-39624" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic. When Fones announced a "Super Secret Squirrel" for the [[2005 Endor Regional]] weekend in October 2004, he wrote that "people who where at game storm this year have a bit of a idea what is to come".<ref name="pcf-3974-54735">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54735#54735 From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend], Edward Fones (ecf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226184856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54272%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
